def register_combat_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: getattr(m, "text", None) == BOSS_CALL_BUTTON)
    def call_active_story_boss(message):
        """Start the canonical location boss only while its story quest is ACTIVE.

        Eligibility is revalidated on every press. After a successful kill,
        Stage 19.19 immediately marks the quest COMPLETED, so stale buttons and
        deliberate delayed turn-in cannot be used to farm guaranteed summons.
        Defeat or escape leaves the quest ACTIVE and permits another attempt.
        """
        user_id = int(message.from_user.id)
        location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
        call = get_active_story_boss_call(user_id=user_id, current_location_id=location_id)
        if not call.get("allowed"):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "⚠️ Виклик сюжетного боса зараз недоступний.", reply_markup=main_kb())
            return
        if get_active_pve_encounter(user_id) is not None:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "⚔️ Спочатку заверши поточний бій.", reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb())
            return
        stats=get_player_stats(user_id)
        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"❗ Спочатку натисни /start",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        lvl=int(stats[-1]);current_hp=get_current_hp_raw(user_id);max_hp=get_max_hp(user_id)
        if max_hp<=0 or (current_hp/max_hp)*100<=25:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"😴 Здоров’я занадто низьке для виклику боса.",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        mob=build_location_boss(location_id,lvl)
        if str(mob.get("boss_key")) != str(call.get("boss_key")):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"⚠️ Ціль сюжетного квесту не відповідає босу цієї локації.",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        mob.update({"potion_cooldown":0,"stunned_turns":0,"skill_cooldowns":{},"enemy_effects":{},"player_effects":{},"last_skill_spent_rage":0,"last_skill_spent_combo":0,"player_hp":current_hp,"player_max_hp":max_hp,"story_boss_call":True})
        init_class_combat_resource(user_id,mob);init_combat_effects(mob)
        encounter=begin_pve_encounter(user_id,message.chat.id,mob)
        mob["pve_encounter_id"]=encounter["encounter_id"];mob["pve_started_at"]=encounter["started_at"];mob["pve_deadline_at"]=encounter["deadline_at"]
        bot.user_data=getattr(bot,"user_data",{});bot.user_data[user_id]=mob
        # Match the canonical hunt startup: replace the persistent location
        # keyboard with the combat placeholder before showing inline actions.
        # This prevents Hunt, Map, Profile and Look Around from remaining usable
        # while the guaranteed story-boss encounter is active.
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "⚔️ Бій розпочався!",
            reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb(),
        )
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"👑 Голова Найманців викликає {mob['name']}!\n\n"
            "Після перемоги потрібно повернутися до Голови Найманців із доповіддю, "
            "а повторний гарантований виклик стане недоступним.",
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id,mob),
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "🔎 Полювання")
    def hunt(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        from systems.travel_system import is_user_travelling
        if is_user_travelling(user_id):
            from keyboards import map_kb
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "🚶 Полювання недоступне під час подорожі.\n\n"
                    "Відкрий мапу, щоб оновити час у дорозі "
                    "або скасувати маршрут."
                ),
                reply_markup=map_kb(),
            )
            return
        if not _combat_message_allowed_11_3_1(message):
            return

        current_location = get_current_location(user_id)
        if current_location == "city":
            from keyboards import city_kb
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "🏙️ У Місті не можна полювати. Відкрий 🗺️ Мапу та вирушай у доступну локацію.",
                reply_markup=city_kb(),
            )
            return

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)


        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Спочатку натисни /start",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        current_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
        max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

        hp_percent = 0

        if max_hp > 0:
            hp_percent = (current_hp / max_hp) * 100

        if hp_percent <= 25:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "😴 Ви занадто слабкі для полювання.\n\n"
                    f"❤️ Здоров’я: {current_hp}/{max_hp} ({hp_percent:.1f}%)\n"
                    "Ваше здоров’я нижче або дорівнює 25%.\n\n"
                    "Відпочиньте або використайте зілля!"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
        location = LOCATIONS.get(location_id, LOCATIONS["start_path"])
        location_max_level = int(location.get("level_max", lvl))

        if lvl > location_max_level:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"🌿 Ця місцевість більше не становить для тебе виклику.\n\n"
                    f"📍 Локація: {location['name']}\n"
                    f"🏷 Рівні локації: {location.get('level_min', 1)}–{location_max_level}\n"
                    f"👤 Твій рівень: {lvl}\n\n"
                    f"Ти занадто сильний для полювання тут.\n"
                    f"Відкрий 🗺️ Мапу та перейди до складнішої локації."
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        energy_result = consume_energy_for_hunt(user_id)

        if not energy_result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                energy_result["message"],
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = generate_mob(player_level=lvl, location_id=location_id)
        mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]
        mob["potion_cooldown"] = 0
        mob["stunned_turns"] = 0
        mob["skill_cooldowns"] = {}
        mob["enemy_effects"] = {}
        mob["player_effects"] = {}
        mob["last_skill_spent_rage"] = 0
        mob["last_skill_spent_combo"] = 0
        mob["player_hp"] = current_hp
        mob["player_max_hp"] = max_hp

        init_class_combat_resource(user_id, mob)
        init_combat_effects(mob)

        bot.user_data = getattr(bot, "user_data", {})
        encounter = begin_pve_encounter(user_id, message.chat.id, mob)
        mob["pve_encounter_id"] = encounter["encounter_id"]
        mob["pve_started_at"] = encounter["started_at"]
        mob["pve_deadline_at"] = encounter["deadline_at"]
        bot.user_data[user_id] = mob

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        attack_type_text = "Фізична" if mob["attack_type"] == "physical" else "Магічна"
        player_attack_type_text = "Фізична" if attack_profile["attack_type"] == "physical" else "Магічна"

        elite_text = ""

        if mob.get("is_boss"):
            elite_text = (
                "👑 БОС ЛОКАЦІЇ!\n"
                "⚠️ Надзвичайно небезпечний ворог із унікальними навичками та фазою Люті.\n\n"
            )
        elif mob.get("is_elite"):
            elite_text = (
                "⭐ ЕЛІТНИЙ ВОРОГ!\n"
                "Ця істота значно сильніша за звичайну.\n\n"
            )

        weapon_text = attack_profile.get("weapon_text") or "Без зброї"
        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"

        text = (
            f"📍 Мапа: {location['name']}\n"
            f"🔎 Ти зустрів {mob['name']}\n\n"
            f"{elite_text}"
            f"======================\n\n"

            f"👤 {character_name}\n"
            f"❤️ Здоров’я: {current_hp}/{max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(current_hp, max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}"
            f"⚔️ Тип атаки: {player_attack_type_text}\n"
            f"🗡️ Зброя: {weapon_text}\n"
            f"💥 Атака: {attack_profile['display_attack']}\n"
            f"🛡 Фіз. захист: {player_pdef}\n"
            f"🔮 Маг. захист: {player_mdef}\n\n"

            f"----------------------\n\n"

            f"👹 {mob['name']}\n"
            f"🏷 Рівень: {mob['level']}\n"
            f"❤️ Здоров’я: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}\n"
            f"⚔️ Атака: {mob['attack']}\n"
            f"🛡 Фіз. захист: {mob.get('pdef', mob.get('def', 0))}\n"
            f"🔮 Маг. захист: {mob.get('mdef', mob.get('def', 0))}\n"
            f"🎯 Тип атаки: {attack_type_text}\n\n"

            f"⚔️ Бій починається!"
        )

        # Спочатку показуємо фальшиву клавіатуру, щоб системна не з'являлася
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "⚔️ Бій розпочався!",
            reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb()
        )
        # Потім показуємо повідомлення про бій з inline меню
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "⚔️ Бій триває...")
    def combat_placeholder(message):
        # Обробник для фальшивої кнопки — нічого не робимо, просто відповідаємо
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
            mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Використовуй інлайн кнопки для бою!",
                reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb()
            )
        else:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Ти не в бою!",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "⚔️ Атакувати")
    def attack(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Спочатку почни полювання",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"

        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        # Використовуємо здоров'я з mob, якщо воно там є, інакше з бази (на випадок старих сесій)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]

        mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(
            mob,
            attack_profile["attack_type"]
        )

        normal_attack_uses_hit_roll = attack_profile["attack_type"] == "physical"

        if normal_attack_uses_hit_roll:
            player_hit_result = roll_player_normal_attack_hit(
                player_dex=dex_,
                mob_dex=mob.get("dex", 0),
            )
            player_attack_hit = bool(player_hit_result["hit"])
        else:
            player_hit_result = None
            player_attack_hit = True

        if player_attack_hit:
            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=attack_profile["stat_attack"],
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=attack_profile["attack_type"],
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"],
                weapon_subtype=attack_profile.get("weapon_subtype", ""),
            )
            dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)
        else:
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0

        mob["hp"] -= dmg

        resource_attack_text = add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = enemy_effect_text

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""

        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"💫 {mob['name']} оглушений і пропускає хід.\n\n"
        else:
            mob_attack_result = _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob=mob,
                player_pdef=player_pdef,
                player_mdef=player_mdef,
                player_dex=dex_,
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
            )

            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]

            shield_text = ""

            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)
            boss_action_text = _finalize_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob, mob_attack_result, mob_dmg
            )

            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp

            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)

            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"💨 УХИЛ! {character_name} уникнув атаки {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:
                enemy_action_text = f"💥 КРИТ {mob['name']}! {character_name} отримав {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"👹 {mob['name']} завдав {character_name} {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"

        if mob.get("is_boss") and 'boss_action_text' in locals() and boss_action_text:
            enemy_action_text = boss_action_text

        if player_hp <= 0:
            defeat_claimed = claim_pve_terminal(user_id, "defeat")
            if not defeat_claimed:
                return

            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id
            )

            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            mp_restore_result = apply_post_combat_mp_floor_17_15_1(user_id)

            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]

            text = build_lethal_combat_log(
                turn_context=locals(),
                player_hp=player_hp,
                player_max_hp=player_max_hp,
                durability_damage=durability_damage,
            )
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1

        text = "⚔️ БІЙ\n\n"

        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text

        if player_effects_text:
            text += player_effects_text

        if resource_start_text:
            text += resource_start_text

        if resource_attack_text:
            text += resource_attack_text

        if enemy_effect_text:
            text += enemy_effect_text

        if resource_damage_text:
            text += resource_damage_text

        if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or enemy_effect_text or resource_damage_text:
            text += "\n"

        if not player_attack_hit:
            text += f"💨 ПРОМАХ! {character_name} не влучив у {mob['name']}"
        elif is_player_crit:
            text += f"💥 КРИТ! {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"
        else:
            text += f"🗡️ {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"


        text += "\n"
        text += enemy_action_text

        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

        text += (
            f"❤️ {character_name}: {player_hp}/{player_max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(player_hp, player_max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}\n"
            f"👹 {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
        )

        text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n\n🔴 Повний шлунок: {mob['potion_cooldown']} ход."


        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "✨ Навички")
    def show_skills(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Ти не в бою",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)

        text, kb = build_skill_menu_text(user_id, mob)

        if not kb:
    
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )
        
    # Старий обробник текстових кнопок скілів (не використовується, тепер використовуємо inline)
    # @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: any(
    #     skill_name in m.text 
    #     for class_skills in CLASS_SKILLS_V1.values() 
    #     for skill_name in [s["name"] for s in class_skills]
    # ))
    def use_skill_text_button(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Ти не в бою",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        class_skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
        
        # Знайти навичку за ім'ям
        skill = None
        for s in class_skills:
            if s["name"] == message.text:
                skill = s
                break
        
        if not skill:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Навичку не знайдено.",
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_result = validate_skill_cooldown(mob, skill)
        if not cooldown_result["success"]:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                cooldown_result["message"],
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)
        
        pay_result = validate_and_pay_skill_cost(user_id, mob, skill)
        if not pay_result["success"]:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                pay_result["message"],
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats
        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)
        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp
        
        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]
            
        skill_attack_type = skill.get("attack_type", attack_profile["attack_type"])
        skill_hit_result = roll_player_pve_skill_hit(
            skill=skill,
            player_dex=dex_,
            player_int=int_,
            mob=mob,
        )
        skill_hit = bool(skill_hit_result["hit"])
        skill_miss_text = "" if skill_hit else "💨 ПРОМАХ! Навичка «{}» не влучила в ціль.\n".format(skill["name"])
        
        if skill.get("no_damage") or not skill_hit:
            base_dmg = 0
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0
        else:
            if skill_attack_type == "magical":
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "magical")
                player_stat_attack = int_
            else:
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "physical")
                player_stat_attack = attack_profile["stat_attack"]
                
            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=player_stat_attack,
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=skill_attack_type,
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"],
                weapon_subtype=attack_profile.get("weapon_subtype", ""),
            )
            
            base_dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)
            
            dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * float(skill.get("damage_multiplier", 1.0)))))
            
            if skill.get("scales_with_spent_rage"):
                spent_rage = mob.get("last_skill_spent_rage", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_rage / 100)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier)))
                
            if skill.get("scales_with_player_pdef"):
                player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(player_pdef * 0.85)))
                
            if skill.get("scales_with_combo"):
                spent_combo = mob.get("last_skill_spent_combo", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_combo * 0.35)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier)))
                
            mob["hp"] -= dmg
            mob["_last_player_damage"] = int(dmg or 0)
            mob["_last_player_crit"] = bool(is_player_crit)
            
        resource_attack_text = ""
        if skill_hit and not skill.get("no_damage"):

        special_effect_text = ""

            )
        
        cooldown_set_text = set_skill_cooldown(

        )
        
        if mob["hp"] <= 0:

def build_daily_quest_text(user_id):
    status = get_daily_quest_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return status["message"], None

    progress = status["progress"]
    target_count = status["target_count"]
    completed = status["completed"]
    reward_claimed = status["reward_claimed"]

    text = (
        "📆 Щоденне завдання\n\n"
        "Місцеві жителі потребують допомоги у боротьбі з монстрами.\n\n"
        "🎯 Ціль:\n"
        f"Вбити {target_count} монстрів\n\n"
        "📈 Прогрес:\n"
        f"{progress}/{target_count}\n\n"
        "🎁 Нагорода:\n"
        "🔴 Мале зілля здоров’я ×3\n"
        f"🪙 Жетон Фіріуса ×{FIRIUS_TOKENS_PER_DAILY_REWARD}\n"
        "ℹ️ Жетони накопичуються та не зникають наступного дня.\n"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    if reward_claimed:
        text += "\n✅ Нагороду за сьогодні вже отримано."
        return text, kb

    if completed:
        text += "\n✅ Завдання виконано. Можна забрати нагороду."

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="🎁 Отримати нагороду",
            callback_data="daily_claim_reward"
        ))

        return text, kb

    text += "\nℹ️ Прогрес зараховується за перемогу над будь-яким монстром."

    return text, kb

def register_dev_handlers(bot):

    # ==============================
    # /give item_id quantity
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["give"])
    def give_item(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        if len(parts) < 2:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "❌ Формат:\n"
                    "/give item_id [quantity]\n\n"
                    "Приклад:\n"
                    "/give 201 5"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        try:
            item_id = int(parts[1])
            quantity = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) >= 3 else 1
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ item_id і quantity мають бути числами.",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        if quantity < 1:
            quantity = 1

        result = add_item(user_id, item_id, quantity)

        if not result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося видати предмет."),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        text = (
            f"✅ DEV: предмет видано.\n\n"
            f"📦 {result.get('name', 'Предмет')} x{result.get('added', 0)}\n"
            f"🎒 Сумка: {result.get('used_slots', 0)}/{result.get('capacity', 20)}"
        )

        if result.get("lost", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n⚠️ Не влізло: x{result.get('lost', 0)}"

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # /setlevel N
    # /lvl N
    # /level N
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["setlevel", "lvl", "level"])
    def set_level(message):

def get_category_items(user_id, category_key):



    items = get_inventory_full_items(user_id)







    if category_key == "all":



        return items







    filtered = []







    for item in items:



        (



            inv_id,



            item_id,



            name,



            type_,



            rarity,



            category,



            slot_key,



            weapon_hands,



            quantity,



            max_stack,



            durability,



            b_str,



            b_dex,



            b_int,



            b_wis,



            b_sta,



            pdef,



            mdef,



            sell_price



        ) = item







        if category_key in SLOT_ORDER:



            if category == "equipment" and slot_key == category_key:



                filtered.append(item)







        elif category_key == "trash":



            if category == "trash":



                filtered.append(item)







        elif category_key == "potion":



            if category == "potion":



                filtered.append(item)







    return filtered

def build_inventory_home(user_id):



    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)



    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)



    free_slots = max(0, capacity - used_slots)







    text = (



        f"🎒 Інвентар\n\n"



        f"🎒 Сумка: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"



        f"✅ Вільно: {free_slots}\n\n"



        # ROM 17.6.1 INVENTORY MOBILE MESSAGE WIDTH



        f"Оберіть потрібний розділ вашого інвентаря:"



    )







    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=2)







    row = []







    for category_key, label in INVENTORY_CATEGORIES:



        count = get_category_count(user_id, category_key)







        if category_key == "all":



            button_text = f"{label} ({used_slots})"



        else:



            button_text = f"{label} ({count})"







        row.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text=button_text,



            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:0"



        ))







        if len(row) == 2:



            kb.add(*row)



            row = []







    if row:



        kb.add(*row)







    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



        text="🔙 Профіль",



        callback_data="inv_profile"



    ))







    return text, kb

def build_category_list(user_id, category_key, page=0):



    items = get_category_items(user_id, category_key)







    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)



    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)



    free_slots = max(0, capacity - used_slots)







    category_label = dict(INVENTORY_CATEGORIES).get(category_key, category_key)







    if not items:



        text = (



            f"{category_label}\n\n"



            f"У цьому розділі немає предметів.\n\n"



            f"🎒 Сумка: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"



            f"✅ Вільно: {free_slots}"



        )







        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()



        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="⬅️ До розділів інвентаря",



            callback_data="inv_home"



        ))







        return text, kb







    total_items = len(items)



    total_pages = max(1, (total_items + ITEMS_PER_PAGE - 1) // ITEMS_PER_PAGE)







    if page < 0:



        page = 0







    if page >= total_pages:



        page = total_pages - 1







    start = page * ITEMS_PER_PAGE



    end = start + ITEMS_PER_PAGE



    page_items = items[start:end]







    text = (



        f"{category_label}\n\n"



        f"🎒 Сумка: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"



        f"✅ Вільно: {free_slots}\n"



        f"📄 Сторінка: {page + 1}/{total_pages}\n\n"



    )







    if category_key in SLOT_ORDER:



        equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)



        equipped_inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(category_key)







        if equipped_inventory_id:



            equipped_item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(equipped_inventory_id)







            if equipped_item:



                equipped_display_name = build_item_display_name(



                    user_id=user_id,



                    inventory_id=equipped_inventory_id,



                    fallback_name=equipped_item[2]



                )







                text += f"✅ Зараз вдягнено: {equipped_display_name}\n\n"



        else:



            text += "Слот порожній.\n\n"







    text += "Оберіть предмет для перегляду або виконання доступної дії:"







    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()







    for item in page_items:



        inv_id = item[0]



        label = build_item_button_label(user_id, item)







        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text=label,



            callback_data=f"item:{inv_id}:{category_key}:{page}"



        ))







    nav_buttons = []







    if page > 0:



        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="⬅️ Назад",



            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:{page - 1}"



        ))







    if page < total_pages - 1:



        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="➡️ Далі",



            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:{page + 1}"



        ))







    if nav_buttons:



        kb.add(*nav_buttons)







    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



        text="⬅️ До розділів інвентаря",



        callback_data="inv_home"



    ))







    return text, kb

def build_item_details(user_id, inventory_id, back_category="all", page=0):



    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)







    if not item:



        text = "❌ Предмет не знайдено"







        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()



        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="⬅️ Назад",



            callback_data=f"invcat:{back_category}:{page}"



        ))







        return text, kb







    (



        inv_id,



        item_id,



        name,



        type_,



        rarity,



        category,



        slot_key,



        weapon_hands,



        quantity,



        max_stack,



        durability,



        b_str,



        b_dex,



        b_int,



        b_wis,



        b_sta,



        pdef,



        mdef,



        sell_price



    ) = item







    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)



    required_level = get_item_required_level_by_inventory_id(inv_id)



    level_ok = player_level >= required_level







    equipped = is_inventory_item_equipped(user_id, inv_id)



    equipped_slot_key = find_equipped_slot_by_inventory_id(user_id, inv_id)







    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()







    display_name = build_item_display_name(



        user_id=user_id,



        inventory_id=inv_id,



        fallback_name=name



    )







    text = f"📦 Предмет\n\n{display_name}\n\n"







    # ==============================



    # TRASH



    # ==============================







    if category == "trash":



        total_price = (quantity or 1) * (sell_price or 0)







        text += (



            f"🔘 Тип: сірий лут\n"



            f"📦 Кількість: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"



            f"💰 Ціна продажу: {sell_price:.2f} золота за шт.\n"



            f"💰 Усього: {total_price:.2f} золота\n\n"



            f"ℹ️ Цей предмет можна продати торговцю в місті."



        )







    # ==============================



    # POTION / SPECIAL ITEM



    # ==============================







    elif category == "potion":



        text += (



            f"🧪 Тип: зілля / особливий предмет\n"



            f"📦 Кількість: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"



            f"💰 Ціна продажу: {sell_price:.2f} золота за шт.\n\n"



        )







        if type_ == "potion_hp":



            text += "❤️ Ефект: відновлює 50 HP\n"



        elif type_ == "potion_hp_medium":



            text += "❤️ Ефект: відновлює 120 HP\n"



        elif type_ == "potion_mp":



            text += "🔵 Ефект: відновлює 40 MP\n"



        elif type_ == "potion_mp_medium":



            text += "🔵 Ефект: відновлює 100 MP\n"



        elif type_ == "class_reset" or item_id == CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID:



            text += (



                "🔮 Ефект: дозволяє змінити клас персонажа.\n"



                "Після використання відкриється вибір нового класу.\n"



            )



        else:



            text += "ℹ️ Ефект предмета поки не описаний.\n"







        text += "\nℹ️ Предмет використовується з інвентаря."







        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="🧪 Використати",



            callback_data=f"usepot:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"



        ))







    # ==============================



    # EQUIPMENT



    # ==============================







    elif category == "equipment":



        slot_label = get_slot_label(slot_key)







        text += (



            f"🧰 Тип: спорядження\n"



            f"🎯 Слот: {slot_label}\n"



        )







        allowed_classes_text = build_item_allowed_classes_text(



            user_id=user_id,



            inventory_id=inv_id



        )







        if allowed_classes_text:



            text += allowed_classes_text







        level_text = "✅" if level_ok else "🔒"







        text += (



            f"🏷 Рівень предмета: {required_level} {level_text}\n"



            f"👤 Твій рівень: {player_level}\n"



        )







        if not level_ok:



            text += f"⚠️ Цей предмет можна буде вдягнути з {required_level} рівня.\n"







        if slot_key == "main_hand":



            if weapon_hands == 2:



                text += "👐 Тип зброї: дворучна\n"



                text += "⚠️ Дворучна зброя блокує другу руку.\n"



            else:



                text += "✋ Тип зброї: одноручна\n"







            weapon_damage_text = get_inventory_weapon_damage_display(inv_id)







            if weapon_damage_text:



                text += f"{weapon_damage_text}\n"







        if durability is not None:



            broken_text = " ⚠️ [ЗЛАМАНО]" if durability <= 0 else ""



            text += f"🧱 Міцність: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n"







        bonuses = format_item_bonuses(



            b_str,



            b_dex,



            b_int,



            b_wis,



            b_sta,



            pdef,



            mdef



        )







        if bonuses:



            text += "\n📊 Бонуси:\n"







            for bonus in bonuses:



                text += f"• {bonus}\n"



        else:



            text += "\n📊 Бонуси: немає\n"







        if durability is not None and durability <= 0:



            text += "\n⚠️ Предмет зламаний і не дає бонусів до ремонту.\n"







        comparison_text = build_equipped_comparison_text(



            user_id=user_id,



            slot_key=slot_key,



            current_inventory_id=inv_id



        )







        if comparison_text:



            text += comparison_text







        if equipped:



            equipped_slot_label = get_slot_label(equipped_slot_key)



            text += f"\n✅ Зараз вдягнено у слот: {equipped_slot_label}"







            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



                text="❌ Зняти",



                callback_data=f"unequip:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"



            ))



        else:



            if level_ok:



                kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



                    text=f"✅ Вдягнути у слот: {slot_label}",



                    callback_data=f"equip:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"



                ))



            else:



                text += "\n🔒 Кнопка вдягання недоступна через недостатній рівень.\n"







    # ==============================



    # OTHER



    # ==============================







    else:



        text += (



            f"📦 Категорія: {category}\n"



            f"📦 Кількість: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"



        )







    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



        text="⬅️ Назад до розділу",



        callback_data=f"invcat:{back_category}:{page}"



    ))







    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



        text="🏠 До розділів інвентаря",



        callback_data="inv_home"



    ))







    return text, kb

def register_inventory_handlers(bot):







    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "🎒 Інвентар")

        bot.send_message(

        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "inv_profile")



    def inventory_profile_callback(call):

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)



        bot.send_message(

        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("invcat:"))



    def inventory_category_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        parts = call.data.split(":")



        category_key = parts[1]



        page = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("equip:"))



    def equip_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        parts = call.data.split(":")



        inventory_id = int(parts[1])



        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "all"



        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0







        result = equip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id)







        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)







        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,

        )

            inventory_id=inventory_id,

        bot.send_message(

            reply_markup=kb



        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("unequip:"))



    def unequip_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        parts = call.data.split(":")



        inventory_id = int(parts[1])



        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "all"



        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0







        result = unequip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id)







        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)







        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            result



        )







        text, kb = build_item_details(



            user_id=user_id,



            inventory_id=inventory_id,



            back_category=back_category,



            page=page



        )







        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            text,



            reply_markup=kb



        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("usepot:"))



    def use_potion_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        parts = call.data.split(":")



        inventory_id = int(parts[1])



        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "potion"



        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0







        # 🔮 Сфера нового шляху



        if is_class_reset_sphere_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):



            result = use_class_reset_sphere_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id)







            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)







            bot.send_message(



                call.message.chat.id,



                result["message"]



            )







            if result.get("success"):



                from handlers.start import start_class_change_flow







                start_class_change_flow(



                    bot=bot,



                    chat_id=call.message.chat.id,



                    user_id=user_id



                )



                return







            text, kb = build_category_list(user_id, back_category, page)







            bot.send_message(



                call.message.chat.id,



                text,



                reply_markup=kb



            )



            return







        # Звичайні зілля



        # ROM 17.5.1.1 KEEP POTION PREVIEW OPEN



        result = use_potion_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id)



        result_message = str(result.get("message") or "Не вдалося використати зілля.")







        if result.get("success"):



            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)



            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, result_message)



            canonical_inventory_id = result.get("inventory_id")



            if canonical_inventory_id is not None:



                text, kb = build_item_details(



                    user_id=user_id,



                    inventory_id=int(canonical_inventory_id),



                    back_category=back_category,



                    page=page,



                )



            else:



                text, kb = build_category_list(user_id, back_category, page)



            try:



                bot.edit_message_text(



                    text,



                    chat_id=call.message.chat.id,



                    message_id=call.message.message_id,



                    reply_markup=kb,



                )



            except Exception:



                try:



                    bot.edit_message_reply_markup(



                        chat_id=call.message.chat.id,



                        message_id=call.message.message_id,



                        reply_markup=None,



                    )



                except Exception:



                    pass



                bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)



            return







        stale_inventory = "Предмет не знайдено в інвентарі" in result_message



        if stale_inventory:



            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, text=result_message, show_alert=True)



            text, kb = build_category_list(user_id, back_category, page)



            try:



                bot.edit_message_text(



                    text,



                    chat_id=call.message.chat.id,



                    message_id=call.message.message_id,



                    reply_markup=kb,



                )



            except Exception:



                try:



                    bot.edit_message_reply_markup(



                        chat_id=call.message.chat.id,



                        message_id=call.message.message_id,



                        reply_markup=None,



                    )



                except Exception:



                    pass



                bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)



            return







        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, text=result_message, show_alert=True)



        return

                "• має максимальний рівень і не може бути покращена далі.\n"

def _send_trade_editor(bot, chat_id, user_id, trade_id, message_id=None):
    """Render and remember every actionable trade editor panel.

    Stage 18.22.6 originally remembered only the later synchronized renderer.
    The recipient's first editor is created through this earlier canonical
    helper, so its Telegram message_id must be captured here as well.
    """
    state = get_player_trade_editor_state(trade_id, user_id)
    if not state.get("success"):
        bot.send_message(chat_id, "ℹ️ Обмін уже неактивний.")
        return
    text = _trade_editor_text(state)
    keyboard = _trade_editor_kb(trade_id, state=state)
    if message_id is not None:
        _safe_edit_message_text(
            bot,
            text,
            chat_id,
            message_id,
            parse_mode="HTML",
            reply_markup=keyboard,
        )
        _remember_player_trade_panel_18_22_6(
            trade_id, user_id, chat_id, message_id
        )
    else:
        sent = bot.send_message(
            chat_id,
            text,
            parse_mode="HTML",
            reply_markup=keyboard,
        )
        sent_id = getattr(sent, "message_id", None)
        if sent_id is not None:
            _remember_player_trade_panel_18_22_6(
                trade_id, user_id, chat_id, sent_id
            )

def profile_inline_kb(active_tab="character"):

    """

    Inline-навігація між вкладками профілю.



    active_tab:

    - character

    - stats

    - equipment

    - skills



    Поточна вкладка НЕ показується як кнопка.

    """



    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=2)



    buttons = []



    if active_tab != "character":

        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(

            text="👤 Персонаж",

            callback_data="profile_character"

        ))



    if active_tab != "stats":

        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(

            text="📊 Параметри",

            callback_data="profile_stats"

        ))



    if active_tab != "equipment":

        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(

            text="🧰 Екіпірування",

            callback_data="profile_equipment"

        ))



    if active_tab != "attributes":

        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(

            text="⭐ Характеристики",

            callback_data="profile_attributes"

        ))



    if active_tab != "skills":

        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(

            text="✨ Навички",

            callback_data="profile_skills"

        ))



    # Розподіл кнопок по два елементи в рядку.

    for index in range(0, len(buttons), 2):

        kb.row(*buttons[index:index + 2])



    return kb

def build_character_text(user_id):

    process_passive_regeneration(user_id)

    reset_daily_hunts_if_needed(user_id)

    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)



    if not stats:

        return "❗ Персонажа не знайдено. Натисни /start."



    str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats



    current_hp = get_current_hp(user_id)

    max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)



    energy_data = get_user_energy(user_id)

    energy = energy_data["energy"]

    max_energy = energy_data["max_energy"]



    progress = get_user_progress(user_id)



    if progress:

        exp = progress["exp"]

        exp_to_next = progress["exp_to_next"]

def build_equipment_text(user_id):

    from db import SLOT_ORDER, EQUIPMENT_SLOTS

    text = (

        f"🧰 Екіпірування персонажа\n\n"

        f"Стан активних слотів:\n\n"

    )



    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:

        slot_label = EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.get(slot_key, slot_key)

        inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(slot_key)



        if not inventory_id:

            text += f"{slot_label}: порожньо\n\n"

            continue



        item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)



        if not item:

            text += f"{slot_label}: помилка предмета\n\n"

            continue



        (

            inv_id,

            item_id,

            name,

            type_,

            rarity,

            category,

            item_slot_key,

            weapon_hands,

            quantity,

            max_stack,

            durability,

            b_str,

            b_dex,

            b_int,

            b_wis,

            b_sta,

            pdef,

            mdef,

            sell_price

        ) = item



        text += f"{slot_label}: {name}\n"



        if durability is not None:

            broken_text = " ⚠️ [ЗЛАМАНО]" if durability <= 0 else ""

            text += f"🧱 Міцність: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n"



        if item_slot_key == "main_hand":

            if weapon_hands == 2:

                text += "👐 Тип зброї: дворучна\n"

            else:

                text += "✋ Тип зброї: одноручна\n"



            weapon_damage_text = get_inventory_weapon_damage_display(inv_id)



            if weapon_damage_text:

                text += f"{weapon_damage_text}\n"



        bonuses = format_equipment_bonuses(

            b_str,

            b_dex,

            b_int,

            b_wis,

            b_sta,

            pdef,

            mdef

        )



        if bonuses:

            text += "📊 Бонуси:\n"



            for bonus in bonuses:

                text += f"• {bonus}\n"

        else:

            text += "📊 Бонуси: немає\n"



        text += "\n"



    return text

def build_refine_items_kb(user_id, page=0):
    items = get_refinable_inventory_items(user_id)
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    if not items:
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="🔙 Закрити",
            callback_data="refine_close"
        ))
        return kb

    total_pages = max(1, (len(items) + REFINE_ITEMS_PER_PAGE - 1) // REFINE_ITEMS_PER_PAGE)
    page = max(0, min(page, total_pages - 1))

    start = page * REFINE_ITEMS_PER_PAGE
    end = start + REFINE_ITEMS_PER_PAGE

    for item in items[start:end]:
        prefix = "⚔️" if item["refine_kind"] == "weapon" else "🛡️"
        status = f"+{item['current_level']}/{item['max_level']}"

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=f"{prefix} {item['name']} ({status})",
            callback_data=f"refine_item:{item['inventory_id']}:{page}"
        ))

    nav_buttons = []

    if page > 0:
        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="⬅️ Назад",
            callback_data=f"refine_page:{page - 1}"
        ))

    if page < total_pages - 1:
        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="➡️ Далі",
            callback_data=f"refine_page:{page + 1}"
        ))

    if nav_buttons:
        kb.row(*nav_buttons)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="❌ Закрити",
        callback_data="refine_close"
    ))

    return kb

def build_refine_effect_text(info, check):
    refine_kind = check.get("refine_kind", "")
    current_level = int(info.get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
    max_level = int(check.get("max_level", 0) or 0)

    if refine_kind == "weapon":
        current_effect = get_weapon_refine_damage_multiplier(current_level)
        next_effect = get_weapon_refine_damage_multiplier(min(current_level + 1, max_level))

        text = (
            "⚔️ Ефект заточки зброї:\n"
            f"• Поточний множник шкоди: ×{current_effect:.2f}\n"
        )

        if current_level < max_level:
            text += f"• Після успіху: ×{next_effect:.2f}\n"

        return text

    if refine_kind == "armor":
        rarity = info.get("rarity", "common")
        current_effect = get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(current_level, rarity)
        next_effect = get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(min(current_level + 1, max_level), rarity)

        text = (
            "🛡️ Ефект заточки броні:\n"
            f"• Поточний бонус HP: +{format_percent(current_effect)}%\n"
        )

        if current_level < max_level:
            text += f"• Після успіху: +{format_percent(next_effect)}% HP\n"

        return text

    return ""

def build_refine_risk_text(info, check):
    refine_kind = check.get("refine_kind", "")
    current_level = int(info.get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
    max_level = int(check.get("max_level", 0) or 0)

    if current_level >= max_level:
        return "✅ Предмет уже має максимальний рівень заточки.\n"

    chance = get_refine_success_chance(refine_kind, current_level)
    failure_level = get_refine_failure_level(refine_kind, current_level)

    text = f"🎲 Шанс успіху: {chance}%\n"

    if failure_level < current_level:
        text += f"❌ При невдачі: +{current_level} → +{failure_level}\n"
    else:
        text += f"❌ При невдачі: +{current_level} без змін\n"

    return text

def register_rune_master_shop_handlers(bot):
    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "🛒 Крамниця")
    def show_rune_master_shop(message):
        _clear_rune_master_shop_quantity_state_10_13_0(message.from_user.id)
        text, keyboard = build_rune_master_shop(message.from_user.id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=keyboard)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("rs:"))
    def rune_master_shop_callback(call):
        # ROM 10.13.1 SHOP REFRESH NO-OP GUARD
        from db import buy_simple_rune_extractor
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        action = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "home"
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        if action == "quantity":
            _RUNE_MASTER_SHOP_QUANTITY_STATE_10_13_0[int(user_id)] = True
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                build_rune_master_shop_quantity_prompt(user_id),
                reply_markup=rune_master_kb(),
            )
            return
        _clear_rune_master_shop_quantity_state_10_13_0(user_id)
        if action in ("buy", "confirm"):
            result = buy_simple_rune_extractor(user_id, int(parts[2]))
            shop_text, keyboard = build_rune_master_shop(user_id)
            text = result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося виконати покупку.") + "\n\n" + shop_text
        else:
            text, keyboard = build_rune_master_shop(user_id)
        try:
            bot.edit_message_text(
                text,
                call.message.chat.id,
                call.message.message_id,
                reply_markup=keyboard,
            )
        except Exception as error:
            # Telegram returns HTTP 400 when Refresh produces exactly the same
            # text and inline keyboard. This is a successful no-op, not a bot error.
            if "message is not modified" not in str(error).lower():
                raise

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: (
        int(message.from_user.id) in _RUNE_MASTER_SHOP_QUANTITY_STATE_10_13_0
        and message.text not in _RUNE_MASTER_SHOP_NAVIGATION_TEXTS_10_13_0
    ))
    def rune_master_shop_quantity_input(message):
        from db import get_rune_master_shop_state
        user_id = int(message.from_user.id)
        try:
            quantity = int(str(message.text or "").strip())
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Введіть ціле число від 1 до 100.", reply_markup=rune_master_kb())
            return
        if quantity < 1 or quantity > 100:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Введіть ціле число від 1 до 100.", reply_markup=rune_master_kb())
            return
        state = get_rune_master_shop_state(user_id)
        total_price = round(float(state["simple_price"]) * quantity, 2)
        if float(state["gold"]) + 1e-9 < total_price:
            affordable = min(100, int(float(state["gold"]) // float(state["simple_price"])))
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Недостатньо золота.\n\n"
                f"Кількість: {quantity}\n"
                f"Загальна ціна: {total_price:g} золота\n"
                f"Доступно: {state['gold']:g} золота\n"
                f"Максимально можна придбати: {affordable}",
                reply_markup=rune_master_kb(),
            )
            return
        _clear_rune_master_shop_quantity_state_10_13_0(user_id)
        text, keyboard = build_rune_master_shop_confirmation(user_id, quantity)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=keyboard)

def register_start_handlers(bot):

    # ==============================
    # /start
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["start"])
    def start(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        continue_registration_or_main(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=message.chat.id,
            user_id=user_id
        )

    # ==============================
    # CHARACTER NAME INPUT
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME)
    def receive_character_name(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if message.text and message.text.startswith("/"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "ℹ️ Спочатку введи ім’я персонажа."
            )
            return

        result = set_character_name(user_id, message.text)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME.discard(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result["message"]
        )

        if needs_character_class(user_id):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_class_selection_text(user_id, mode="register"),
                reply_markup=build_class_selection_kb(mode="register")
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # INITIAL CLASS SELECTION
    # ==============================

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("legacy_disabled_select_class:"))
    def select_class(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        class_key = call.data.split(":")[1]

        result = set_character_class(user_id, class_key)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            (
                f"{result['message']}\n\n"
                f"Твій шлях починається."
            )
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # CLASS CHANGE BY SPHERE
    # ==============================

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("legacy_disabled_change_class:"))
    def change_class(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        class_key = call.data.split(":")[1]

        if not has_class_change_available(user_id):
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❌ Зміна класу недоступна."
            )
            return

        old_class = get_character_class_display(user_id)

        result = set_character_class(user_id, class_key)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        consume_result = consume_class_change_available(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        # Character System returns bool for consume_class_change_available().
        # Keep compatibility with a possible historical dict result as well.
        if isinstance(consume_result, dict):
            consume_success = bool(consume_result.get("success"))
            consume_message = consume_result.get(
                "message",
                "❌ Не вдалося використати право на зміну класу."
            )
        else:
            consume_success = bool(consume_result)
            consume_message = "❌ Не вдалося використати право на зміну класу."

        if not consume_success:
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                consume_message
            )
            return

        unequip_result = unequip_incompatible_items_after_class_change(user_id)
        unequip_text = build_class_change_unequip_text_local(unequip_result)
        new_class_name = (
            result.get("class_name")
            or get_character_class_display(user_id)
            or result.get("class_key")
            or class_key
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            (
                f"🔮 Клас змінено.\n\n"
                f"Було: {old_class}\n"
                f"Стало: {new_class_name}"
                f"{unequip_text}"
            )
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

def _player_stats(user_id: int):
    """Return canonical primary stats without assuming a mapping representation.

    `db.get_player_stats` currently returns the six-value tuple
    `(STR, DEX, INT, WIS, STA, level)`. Older tests and integrations may supply
    mappings or row-like objects, so the adapter preserves the value unchanged.
    Story-boss presentation does not derive location from this value.
    """
    getter = getattr(db, "get_player_stats", None)
    return getter(user_id) if callable(getter) else None

def _presentation_for_user(user_id: int):
    stats = _player_stats(user_id)
    location_id = _location_id(user_id, stats)
    call = _active_call(user_id, location_id)
    # Eligibility denials are non-empty dictionaries. Render only the explicit
    # canonical allow contract; all missing/false/non-boolean values fail closed.
    if not call or _value(call, "allowed", default=False) is not True:
        return None
    from systems.story_boss_invocation_adapter import StoryBossInvocationState
    current = int(_value(call, "progress_current", "current", "progress", default=0) or 0)
    target = int(_value(call, "progress_target", "target", "target_quantity", default=1) or 1)
    quest_number = int(_value(call, "quest_number", "number", default=49) or 49)
    status = str(_value(call, "quest_status", "status", default="ACTIVE") or "ACTIVE")
    state = StoryBossInvocationState(
        quest_number=quest_number,
        quest_status=status,
        progress_current=current,
        progress_target=target,
        expected_location_id=str(_value(call, "location_id", "expected_location_id", default="start_path") or "start_path"),
        current_location_id=location_id,
        has_active_encounter=False,
        has_active_travel=False,
        is_busy=False,
    )
    return build_story_boss_look_around_presentation(state)

def _delegate_invoke(bot, call):
    """Delegate through the canonical message handler with callback-user identity.

    Telegram callback messages were authored by the bot, so
    `call.message.from_user` is not the player who pressed the inline button.
    The canonical combat handler reads `message.from_user.id`; provide an
    adapter carrying `call.from_user` while preserving the source chat.
    """
    handler = _canonical_call_handler(bot)
    source_message = call.message
    player_message = SimpleNamespace(
        from_user=call.from_user,
        chat=source_message.chat,
        text=getattr(source_message, "text", None),
        message_id=getattr(source_message, "message_id", None),
        date=getattr(source_message, "date", None),
        content_type=getattr(source_message, "content_type", "text"),
    )
    # The canonical owner revalidates quest, location, encounter and retry eligibility.
    handler(player_message)

def _active_story_boss_callback_call(user_id: int, expected_quest_number: int):
    """Return an ACTIVE production BOSS quest without applying an invoke location gate.

    HELP is intentionally available from the city NPC, while the actual INVOKE
    branch still calls `_presentation_for_user`, which revalidates the current
    quest location, progress, travel and encounter state before combat starts.
    """
    from data.story_quest_content import STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY
    from data.story_quest_definitions import QuestType
    from db_modules.story_quests import get_active_story_quest

    active = get_active_story_quest(db.conn, int(user_id))
    if active is None:
        return None
    quest = STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY.get(str(active["quest_id"]))
    if quest is None or quest.quest_type is not QuestType.BOSS:
        return None
    if int(quest.number) != int(expected_quest_number):
        return None
    if str(active["status"]).upper() != "ACTIVE":
        return None
    return {
        "allowed": True,

def render_story_quest_journal(
    items: Sequence[Mapping], *, page: int = 0, page_size: int = STORY_QUEST_PAGE_SIZE,
) -> dict:
    """Render a paginated, UI-neutral journal snapshot.

    Items are expected to come from the lifecycle view layer. The formatter does
    not query SQLite, infer NPC routes, or duplicate lifecycle decisions.
    """
    size = max(1, min(STORY_QUEST_PAGE_SIZE, int(page_size)))
    ordered = sorted(items, key=lambda item: (int(item.get("number", 0)), str(item.get("quest_id", ""))))
    max_page = max(0, (len(ordered) - 1) // size) if ordered else 0
    current = min(max(0, int(page)), max_page)
    visible = ordered[current * size:(current + 1) * size]
    if not visible:
        text = "📜 Сюжетні квести\n\nЖурнал поки порожній."
    else:
        lines = ["📜 Сюжетні квести", ""]
        for item in visible:
            number = int(item.get("number", 0))
            title = str(item.get("title") or "Без назви")
            status = str(item.get("status") or "LOCKED")
            lines.append(f"{number}. {title}")
            lines.append(f"   {_status_label(status)}")
            if status == "ACTIVE":
                progress = int(item.get("quest_item_quantity", 0) or item.get("progress", 0))
                target = int(item.get("target_quantity", 1))
                lines.append(f"   Прогрес: {min(progress, target)}/{target}")
        lines += ["", f"Сторінка {current + 1}/{max_page + 1}"]
        text = "\n".join(lines)
    quest_rows = [
        [_button(
            f"{STATUS_LABELS.get(str(item.get('status') or 'LOCKED'),'❓')} {int(item.get('number',0))}. {str(item.get('title') or 'Без назви')}",
            build_story_quest_callback("detail", str(item.get("quest_id") or "")),
        )]
        for item in visible
    ]
    return {
        "text": text,
        "page": current,
        "page_size": size,
        "total": len(ordered),
        "has_previous": current > 0,
        "has_next": current < max_page,
        "keyboard": quest_rows + build_story_quest_journal_keyboard(
            page=current, has_previous=current > 0, has_next=current < max_page,
        ),
        "visible_quest_ids": [str(item.get("quest_id", "")) for item in visible],
    }

def build_production_story_quest_detail(connection, *, user_id: int, quest_id: str, player_level: int, page: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Render one canonical definition plus current lifecycle state.

    Acceptance remains NPC-owned. The journal only explains the objective,
    route, progress, reward, and unlock prerequisites.
    """
    import db
    from data.story_quest_content import STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY
    from data.story_quest_npcs import resolve_story_quest_navigation
    from systems.story_quest_system import get_story_quest_view
    try:
        quest = STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY[str(quest_id)]
    except KeyError as error:
        raise StoryQuestUiError(f"unknown production story quest: {quest_id}") from error
    view = get_story_quest_view(connection, user_id=int(user_id), quest=quest, player_level=int(player_level))
    status = str(view["status"])
    progress = max(int(view.get("progress",0)), int(view.get("quest_item_quantity",0)))
    from data.story_quest_title_presentation import resolve_story_quest_presentation_title
    presentation_title = resolve_story_quest_presentation_title(quest, status, int(view.get("quest_item_quantity", 0)))
    lines = [f"📜 {quest.number}. {presentation_title}", "", f"Статус: {_status_label(status)}", "", "📖 Опис:", quest.description, "", "🎯 Завдання:", quest.objective_text]
    if _should_show_story_quest_progress(status, quest):
        lines += ["", "📈 Прогрес:", f"{min(progress,quest.target_quantity)}/{quest.target_quantity}"]
    if status == "ACTIVE" and quest.quest_type is QuestType.BOSS and progress >= int(quest.target_quantity):
        lines += [
            "",
            "✅ Ватажка переможено.",
            "Повернися до Голови Найманців із доповіддю.",
        ]
    if status == "ACTIVE" and quest.quest_type is QuestType.QUEST_ITEM and quest.quest_item is not None:
        if progress >= int(quest.quest_item.required_quantity):
            lines += ["", "✅ Знахідку отримано:", quest.quest_item.display_name]
        else:
            lines += ["", "🔎 Стан пошуку:", "Доказ ще не знайдено."]
    if status == "LOCKED":
        lines += ["", "🔒 Для відкриття:"]
        if quest.previous_quest_id:
            previous = STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY.get(quest.previous_quest_id)
            lines.append(f"• завершити квест {previous.number if previous else '?'} «{previous.title if previous else quest.previous_quest_id}»")
        lines.append(f"• досягти {quest.unlock_level} рівня")
    journal_navigation = resolve_story_quest_journal_navigation(quest, status, progress)
    if journal_navigation is not None:
        route_label, route_text = journal_navigation
        lines += ["", route_label, route_text]
    lines += ["", "🎁 Нагорода:", f"{quest.reward.exp} EXP", f"{float(quest.reward.gold):.2f} золота"]
    return {"text":"\n".join(lines),"keyboard":build_story_quest_detail_keyboard(quest_id=quest.quest_id,status=status,page=page)}

def allocate_attribute_points(
    user_id: int,
    allocation: Mapping[str, int],
    *,
    expected_free_attribute_points: int | None = None,
    db_module=None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Atomically allocate points and return before/after state.

    `expected_free_attribute_points` is an optimistic concurrency token for UI
    confirmation. A repeated or stale confirmation fails instead of spending a
    newer balance.
    """
    normalized = normalize_allocation(allocation)
    spent = sum(normalized.values())
    database = _db_module(db_module)
    connection = database.conn
    cursor = database.cursor

    if connection.in_transaction:
        raise AttributeAllocationError(
            "allocate_attribute_points requires ownership of its transaction"
        )

    connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        before = _fetch_state(cursor, int(user_id))
        if expected_free_attribute_points is not None:
            if isinstance(expected_free_attribute_points, bool) or not isinstance(
                expected_free_attribute_points, int
            ):
                raise InvalidAllocationError(
                    "expected_free_attribute_points must be an integer or None"
                )
            if before.free_attribute_points != expected_free_attribute_points:
                raise StaleAttributeStateError(
                    "Attribute point balance changed; refresh before confirming"
                )
        if spent > before.free_attribute_points:
            raise InsufficientAttributePointsError(
                f"Not enough free attribute points: required={spent}, "
                f"available={before.free_attribute_points}"
            )

        cursor.execute(
            """UPDATE users SET
                   free_attribute_points = free_attribute_points - ?,
                   allocated_strength = allocated_strength + ?,
                   allocated_dexterity = allocated_dexterity + ?,
                   allocated_intelligence = allocated_intelligence + ?,
                   allocated_wisdom = allocated_wisdom + ?,
                   allocated_stamina = allocated_stamina + ?
                 WHERE user_id=? AND free_attribute_points >= ?""",
            (
                spent,
                normalized["strength"],
                normalized["dexterity"],
                normalized["intelligence"],
                normalized["wisdom"],
                normalized["stamina"],
                int(user_id),
                spent,
            ),
        )
        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            raise StaleAttributeStateError(
                "Attribute point state changed during confirmation"
            )
        after = _fetch_state(cursor, int(user_id))
        if after.total_attribute_points_earned != before.total_attribute_points_earned:
            raise AttributeInvariantError("Allocation cannot change total earned points")
        connection.commit()
    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        raise

    return {
        "user_id": int(user_id),
        "spent": spent,
        "allocation": normalized,
        "before": before.to_dict(),
        "after": after.to_dict(),
    }
